summary: Implemented App.call_from_thread in src/textual/app.py, with thread-entry state initialized in __init__ and set/cleared in run_async's try/finally. Added tests/test_call_from_thread.py with 9 tests, all passing on the recorded Python 3.9 venv when run with PYTHONPATH=$PWD/src (the venv's textual install points at base/). The full non-snapshot suite shows 68 failures both with and without my change, caused by the environment (no async test plugin, missing aiohttp for devtools/cli). Nothing was committed.
